rubric.formula: 2*impact + evidence_deficit + architectural_leverage + validation_tractability + symptom_relevance + primary_need - 2*duplication_penalty - blocker_penalty

selected_target: Opening edge to physical wake critical path — explain and decompose the captured ~166 ms shell latency without touching smooth close behavior.

top_candidate.target: Opening edge to physical wake critical path
top_candidate.mechanism: Decompose accepted edge -> app dispatch -> Binder/shell -> stable physical-id resolution -> SurfaceControl.setDisplayPowerMode -> HWC completion; determine Duo-controlled versus platform-controlled latency.
top_candidate.observed_signal: Final field opening: queue ~0.904 ms, shell ~166 ms, total ~168.245 ms, ok=true. Current wake primitive and startup physical-id priming are byte-for-byte identical to 1.3.29 fast lineage.
top_candidate.evidence: DEV+SRC+PLT: physical field timing; current/main vs 8f844ba8 source comparison; Android 16 SurfaceFlinger setPowerMode schedules on SF main thread and future.wait().
top_candidate.prior_work_status: Earlier readiness/lifetime work exists, but current 166 ms internal shell phase is not decomposed; fresh slot01 owns historical regression archaeology.
top_candidate.representation_in_main: Only outer queue/total and one shell total latency; no resolve-vs-SF/HWC split.
top_candidate.independent_boundary: latency instrumentation/critical path only; no historical lane ownership and no close-path changes

why_selected: Highest non-duplicative score. Field data already localizes nearly all measured wake-command latency inside the shell/platform call. The core wake primitive is unchanged from the fast lineage, creating a precise, high-leverage question: which substage is now taking ~166 ms and which part is under Duo control?

why_not_runners_up.4: important but prior readiness research exists and final proof is more device-coupled
why_not_runners_up.3: material prior semantic-lifetime work raises duplication penalty
why_not_runners_up.9: useful validation lane but final physical gate is device-blocked and should consume root-cause instrumentation
why_not_runners_up.6: strong overlap with active slot07 and slot05
why_not_runners_up.1: actively claimed by fresh slot01 worker
why_not_runners_up.5: actively claimed by fresh slot05 worker
why_not_runners_up.7: actively claimed and already confirmed by fresh slot07 work

overlap: Consumes slot01 historical result when available but does not identify last-good build; does not change Gen4 terminal ordering, crash recovery, or closing thresholds.
independent_boundary: Measure/design only the edge->WakeInner->Binder/shell->SurfaceFlinger/HWC physical-wake command path and warm/cold concurrency around it.
cheapest_decisive_first_action: Split current shellLatencyMs into physical-id resolution, display-token lookup, and SurfaceControl.setDisplayPowerMode durations; correlate with Android 16 SF/HWC power timing and Gen4 cover-mutation activity.
